channel.title: Weekly Digest
channel.description: Curated from your sources in English, Spanish and Catalan

item.title: AI leaders urge slowdown as OpenAI postpones market listing
item.description: Executives at Anthropic, OpenAI and Google DeepMind called for slower AI development on safety grounds, and OpenAI delayed its planned share listing. President Trump publicly dismissed the warnings. Why it matters: The first coordinated call for restraint from the companies building the technology. (Sources: BBC World, El País, La Vanguardia, Nació Digital, Público, RAC1, RTVE, TechCrunch, VilaWeb, eldiario.es)

item.title: Swedish centre-left wins narrowly as far right loses ground
item.description: With almost all votes counted, Sweden's centre-left opposition led the governing bloc 49.5% to 49.1%, a margin of three seats. Support for the far right fell. Why it matters: A three-seat margin decides whether the far right can enter government. (Sources: 3Cat (324), Ara, El País, La Vanguardia, Público, RTVE, VilaWeb, eldiario.es)

item.title: Six dead and 130 missing after ferry capsizes in Java Sea
item.description: A passenger ferry overturned in the Java Sea. Authorities confirmed six deaths and 130 people unaccounted for, with 107 rescued and more than a dozen vessels joining the search. Why it matters: Most passengers remain missing while the search continues. (Sources: Al Jazeera, BBC World, NPR News, RAC1, The Guardian World)

item.title: Catalonia stages its national day in Extremadura
item.description: Catalan president Salvador Illa will hold this year's Diada commemoration in Extremadura, honouring emigrants. The government plans to mark the day in a different region each year. Why it matters: A deliberate change in how Catalonia stages its national day. (Sources: 3Cat (324), Ara, RAC1)

item.title: Israeli minister seeks to strip documentary makers of citizenship
item.description: Israel's culture minister said he wants to revoke the citizenship of the directors of a documentary on Gaza that won a special jury prize at the Venice film festival. Why it matters: A government moving against filmmakers over a prize-winning documentary. (Sources: Ara, eldiario.es)

item.title: BRICS summit closes in New Delhi divided over Iran and Ukraine
item.description: Leaders met for the final day of the BRICS summit in New Delhi, where coverage focused on divisions within the bloc over the wars in Iran and Ukraine. Why it matters: Exposes the limits of the bloc's cohesion on major conflicts. (Sources: Al Jazeera, BBC World)

item.title: Trump repeats support for a united Ireland during visit
item.description: Speaking at the Irish Open on the second day of his visit, President Trump restated his support for a united Ireland, saying many people agreed with him. Why it matters: An unusual intervention in Northern Ireland's constitutional question. (Sources: BBC World, The Guardian World)

item.title: Zverev beats Shelton for his first US Open title
item.description: Alexander Zverev defeated Ben Shelton in four sets to win the US Open, his second Grand Slam title. (Sources: Al Jazeera, La Vanguardia, RTVE)

item.title: Enric Mas wins the Vuelta a España
item.description: Enric Mas won the Vuelta a España, the first Spanish victory in the race for 12 years, decided on the final stage in Granada. (Sources: La Vanguardia, RTVE)

item.title: Barcelona win at Levante after a late scare
item.description: Barcelona won away at Levante, conceding late after establishing a three-goal lead. (Sources: Ara, RAC1)
